root_cause.text: The `mana_gd_cleanup()` function in the MANA network driver unconditionally destroys the `service_wq` workqueue without verifying if it has already been freed, resulting in a double-free when the cleanup routine is invoked twice during a failed device resume followed by PCI device removal.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `gdma_main.c` to wrap `destroy_workqueue(gc->service_wq)` with a `if (gc->service_wq)` check and sets the pointer to `NULL` after destruction, preventing the second invocation from `mana_gd_remove` (triggered by `pci_stop_and_remove_bus_device`) from attempting to free memory already released during `mana_gd_suspend`.
